description.sub_name: 人工智慧自然語言導論
description.sub_ename: INTRODUCTION TO NATURAL LANGUAGE AND ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
description.describe_ch: 自然語言處理是人工智慧和語言學領域的其一分支學科，主要研究如何讓電腦處理和運用自然語言。自然語言處理廣義上分為兩大部分，第一部分為自然語言了解，意旨電腦如何理解人類的語言；第二部分為自然語言產生，是指把電腦資料轉化為自然語言。透過這門課程同學可瞭解如何將句子轉換成電腦能夠理解的方法，包含句子斷詞(CKIP、JIBEA)、自詞向量化(Word2Vec、Fasttext)方法的優缺點，此外也將介紹常見語言模型RNN、LSTM以及Transformer等架構進而演示模型如何進行翻譯的應用、句子等級分類以及摘要生成等實際結果。
description.describe_eh: Natural language processing is a branch of artificial intelligence and linguistics. The research focuses on how to make computers process and apply it. Natural language processing is divided into two parts in a broad sense. The first one is natural language understanding, which means how the computer understands; the second one is natural language generation, which refers to the conversion of computer data into natural language. Through this course, students can learn how to convert sentences into the things that computers can understand. The course includes the advantages and disadvantages of sentence segmentation (CKIP, JIBEA…) and the tokenization (Word2Vec, FastText…) methods. In addition, it will also introduce the architectures of common language models such as RNN, LSTM, and Transformer. Then i will demonstrate how the model is applied for translation, sentence level classification, and abstract generation.

iSoftwares.soft_memo: 本課程將於課堂中實作 NLP 相關程式實作與模型訓練，並且安排作業與相關學習活動。為確保學生能即時完成實作，課程需要使用電腦教室，以進行 Google Colab 與 VS code  等開發工作之操作。

weeklyScds.tpd_reading: 課程介紹與自然語言介紹 (Syllabus & Foundations of NLP)
weeklyScds.tpd_ass: 說明自然語言處理（NLP）的研究範疇與應用場景，介紹語言的層次（詞彙、句法、語意、語用）以及本課程的任務導向學習架構。
探討中文斷詞與詞彙切分問題，介紹規則式方法（FSM、FMM）與資料結構（Trie），並說明其在實務應用中的限制與挑戰。
說明詞性標註任務與語法角色，介紹 HMM 的基本概念，理解如何利用機率模型進行序列標註。

weeklyScds.tpd_reading: 命名實體識別（Named Entity Recognition）
weeklyScds.tpd_ass: 定義命名實體類型（人名、地名、組織等），說明序列標註任務在資訊抽取中的角色，並介紹 CRF 模型的基本概念。
探討如何從文本中抽取代表性詞彙，介紹 BOW 與 TF-IDF 作為文本表示方法，並分析其在主題判斷中的應用。
延伸關鍵字提取至短語層級，介紹 N-gram、PMI 與 BM25，說明如何結合統計方法判斷重要短語。
說明句子結構分析的目的，介紹 CFG 與語法樹（Parse Tree），並探討語法歧義（attachment ambiguity）問題。
探討詞義與語意相似度問題，介紹分佈式語意（distributional semantics）概念與詞向量（Word Embedding）作為語意表示方法。
評量學生對前半學期（詞彙分析至語意表示）之理解與應用能力，涵蓋基本概念與簡單分析題。
說明文本分類任務與應用場景（情感分析、垃圾訊息分類等），介紹從特徵表示到分類決策的基本流程。進一步介紹分類任務之評估指標，包括準確率（Accuracy）、精確率（Precision）、召回率（Recall）與 F1-score，說明各指標在不同情境下之適用性與差異。

weeklyScds.tpd_reading: 文本相似度與文件比對 (Text Similarity and Document Matching)
weeklyScds.tpd_ass: 探討文本之間的相似度衡量方式，包含詞彙層級與語意層級的比對方法，應用於重複檢測與語意比對。進一步介紹常用相似度評估指標，包括 Jaccard 係數（Jaccard Coefficient）與餘弦相似度（Cosine Similarity），說明其計算原理與適用情境之差異。

weeklyScds.tpd_reading: 問答系統的設計與原理 (QA System Design)
weeklyScds.tpd_ass: 說明問答系統的基本架構與任務類型（抽取式、生成式），分析問題與文本之間的語意關係。

weeklyScds.tpd_reading: 資訊檢索與問答整合 ( Information Retrieval and QA Integration )
weeklyScds.tpd_ass: 探討查詢（Query）與文件匹配機制，介紹 稀疏式 (Sparse) 和 密集式 (Dense) 方法在資訊檢索中的應用，並說明檢索式問答系統的流程。進一步介紹常用搜尋評估指標，包括精確匹配率（Exact Match, EM）、F1-score 與 Top-k 召回率（Recall@k），說明其在結果排序與答案評估中的意義與適用範圍。
說明語言模型的基本概念，探討文本生成的應用（續寫、對話），理解生成任務與理解任務的差異。進一步介紹常用文本生成評估指標，包括 BLEU、ROUGE 與 METEOR，說明其在參考文本對齊與生成品質評估中的計算原理與適用情境。
探討跨語言轉換問題，介紹語言對齊（alignment）與翻譯策略，理解語意轉換與語法差異的影響。
說明文本摘要的任務與類型（抽取式、生成式），比較其與關鍵字與關鍵短語提取的差異。

weeklyScds.tpd_reading: 生成式語言模型的統一框架 (Unified NLP Tasks through Generative Models)
weeklyScds.tpd_ass: 探討自然語言處理任務在表示形式與建模方法上的統一性，分析各類任務如何被轉化為條件式文本生成問題，並說明生成式語言模型在跨任務語言理解與生成中的整合角色。
學生整合所學完成 NLP 任務應用（如分類、問答或生成系統），並提交書面報告與成果展示。

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Core Values of Academic Integrity
Integrity represents a fundamental attitude and professional value that translates academic ideals into guiding principles of conduct and social responsibility. The essence of academic integrity lies in maintaining a balance between the free exchange of ideas and respect for the intellectual property rights of others.
Student Responsibilities
Students are expected to understand and comply with all regulations concerning intellectual property rights. In academic activities, students may neither provide, use, nor receive unauthorized assistance. The use of library collections, copyrighted instructional materials, and audiovisual resources must adhere to established guidelines. Students are required to uphold integrity, participate actively in class, and demonstrate respect toward all classmates. Responsible and courteous conduct should guide all academic interactions.
Prevention of Academic Misconduct
  • No Cheating: During written examinations, students must not communicate with others, view another student’s test materials, intentionally assist others, or bring, copy, or transmit unauthorized materials. Violations will result in a score of zero for the examination and will be addressed in accordance with the regulations of Feng Chia University.
  • No Plagiarism: All submitted work must be original. Any form of plagiarism is strictly prohibited.
  • No Falsification: Students may not alter grades or official documents, including medical certificates or other formal records.
  • No Fabrication or Data Manipulation: Experimental data must be recorded accurately. The creation of fabricated data or fictitious sources is not permitted.
  • No Sabotage: Students may not damage the artistic works, experimental results, or design projects of others. Failure to contribute appropriately to a group project may also be considered a form of academic misconduct.
All violations will be handled in accordance with the Student Reward and Disciplinary Regulations and other relevant policies of Feng Chia University.
